items.description: A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone.

items.name: DLSS5-Swapper
items.description: DLSS 5 Swapper is a powerful, easy-to-use tool for installing, managing, and restoring DLSS 5 across games and supported emulators. It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.

items.name: DLSS5-Feeder
items.description: DLSS 5 neural rendering in D3D11/D12/Vulkan games that ship without any DLSS — feeds a synthetic DLAA contract (ReShade depth + motion vectors) to the DLSS 5 add-on via a private D3D12 device.
